generated.description: A large replica of the Eiffel Tower in Paris, built mostly from gold blocks with stone, iron bars and iron blocks for the lattice and base details. It stands about 242 blocks tall and roughly 100 by 100 blocks across at the base, and it is a solid-looking landmark with no interior rooms or block entities. Glowstone and torches provide a few lights, and it works best as a showpiece in an open area.
